sn48.51:1.5: The five faculties are “qualities on the side of awakening” (_bodhipakkhiyā dhammā_) because they lead to awakening ([sn48.51:2.6]()). This term is used repeatedly in this Saṁyutta in this sense. Outside of this context, it is used occasionally in the general sense of meditative development, without further specification ([an5.56:3.1]()). In three instances it is extended to “seven” such qualities ([dn27:30.5](), [iti82:3.1](), [iti97:4.2]()), which the commentary identifies with the seven sets of dhammas totaling 37 (rather than the seven awakening factors alone). We also find the synonymous phrase _sambodhipakkhika_ at [an9.1](). At [thag16.9:9.2]() we find qualities that are “skillful, on the side of awakening” (_kusalā bodhipakkhikā_), cementing the connection with the expressions “on the side of the skillful” or “on the side of the unskillful” ([sn46.31:1.1](), [mn117:36.1](), [an1.56:1.1]()). The qualities “on the side of awakening” oppose those “on the side of Māra” ([thag4.4:1.2]()).
